skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: A minimal skill scaffold that shows where authors should add a name, description, and instructions.
skill.summary: Start a custom skill from a simple SKILL.md template.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns, and the only reviewed file is a short placeholder SKILL.md. I found no evidence of executable code, network behavior, secret access, or prompt injection content.

content.value_statement: Starting a new AI skill can be unclear when the required file shape is unfamiliar. This template provides a minimal SKILL.md scaffold that authors can replace with real instructions.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md file with YAML front matter.
Sets the placeholder skill name to template-skill.
Shows a placeholder description field for future authors.
Provides a heading that marks where instructions should be added.
Contains no scripts, network calls, or executable support files.
limitations: It does not include a finished workflow or domain-specific instructions.
The description is still a placeholder and must be replaced before use.
It does not include examples, tests, assets, or helper scripts.
It cannot provide reliable task behavior until the template is customized.

use_cases.title: Start a New Skill
use_cases.description: Use the scaffold as a starting point before writing a custom skill description and instructions.

use_cases.title: Review Minimum Structure
use_cases.description: Check that a new skill has the minimum file shape before adding detailed content.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Authoring
use_cases.description: Demonstrate the smallest practical skill structure in onboarding or documentation material.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Skill Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template as a starting point. Help me write a clear skill description for a skill that handles [task].

prompt_templates.title: Fill Core Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this template into a skill for [workflow]. Draft concise instructions that explain when to use it and what steps to follow.

prompt_templates.title: Add Quality Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my draft skill based on this template. Identify missing capabilities, limitations, examples, and security boundaries before publication.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Marketplace Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the completed skill draft, create marketplace content with capabilities, limitations, use cases, prompt templates, and FAQ entries.

output_examples.input: I need a template for a code review skill.
output_examples.output: A draft description explains when the skill applies, what reviews it performs, and what risks it will not assess.

output_examples.input: Review my filled template before publishing.
output: The description is specific enough for discovery.
The instructions still need concrete workflow steps.
Add limitations that explain unsupported review types.

output_examples.input: Help me turn this scaffold into a documentation skill.
output_examples.output: The completed draft defines its audience, supported document types, review steps, and expected final deliverables.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before publishing the skill.
Write instructions that state when the skill should and should not run.
Add examples and limits that match the real workflow.
anti_patterns: Publishing the template without replacing the placeholder description.
Adding broad claims that the finished skill cannot support.
Using the template to hide unrelated instructions or unsafe requests.

faq.question: Can I publish this skill as it is?
faq.answer: No. It is a scaffold and lacks complete instructions for a real workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill run code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package only contains a short SKILL.md file.

faq.question: What should I replace first?
faq.answer: Replace the description with a clear statement about when the finished skill should be used.

faq.question: Can I use it for Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The scaffold is simple Markdown and can guide skill authoring for Claude Code and Codex workflows.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: No. Authors should add workflow-specific limits and safety rules before publication.

faq.question: Who is this template for?
faq.answer: It is for authors who need a minimal starting point for a custom AI skill.
